purpose: Route knowledge-source signals into concept leaves, source-backed leaves, quarantine, or anchor candidates.

trust_levels.medium: named source with bibliographic context but no direct excerpt/hash
trust_levels.high: direct excerpt, page reference, screenshot, PDF, or source bytes available
trust_levels.anchored: hash, commit, attestation, tx, CID, or other external proof exists

canonicalization.rule: same input bytes and same policy must produce same canonical JSON, same hash, and same route
